title: Density comparison: unit density on A implies Hⁿ(A) ≤ μ(A) (Simon Ch. 1 Thm 3.3; parent Step 4)
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, let μ be a Borel measure on ℝ^N with μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^N, and let A ⊆ ℝ^N be an arbitrary set such that, for every x ∈ A, μ(B̄_ρ(x))/ρⁿ → ω_n := Lⁿ(B_1(0)) in [0, ∞] as ρ ↓ 0. Then Hⁿ(A) ≤ μ(A), where Hⁿ = μHE[n] and both sides are outer-measure values.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (A : Set (Rn N)), (∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → (∀ x ∈ A, Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ μ (Metric.closedBall x ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (volume (Metric.ball (0 : Rn n) 1)))) → μHE[n] A ≤ μ A
